Andhra Pradesh Minister Pitches State to US Investors

Andhra Pradesh Industries Minister Gudivada Amarnath, referred to as Bharath in the coverage, visited New York to promote the state as an investment destination. He met with potential investors, inviting them to consider Andhra Pradesh for their business ventures. The outreach aims to attract foreign capital and foster economic growth in the state.
